summary: Verified bulk-delete customers backend + full frontend E2E, plus Unregistered Leases sticky headers and Showing-N counts. 8/9 assertions PASS. One backend bug found: bulk-delete with invalid UUID returns 500 instead of 422.

minor.issue: Body { customer_ids: ['not-a-valid-uuid'] } returns 500 Server Error instead of 422. Root cause: validation rule is `customer_ids.* => string|exists:customers,id`; when the input is not a valid UUID, Postgres raises SQLSTATE 22P02 (invalid input syntax for type uuid) during the `exists` lookup before Laravel can format a 422. Fix: add the `uuid` rule before `exists`, i.e. `customer_ids.* => 'required|uuid|exists:customers,id'`. All other cases (200 with deleted:3+404s, 422 for empty array, 401 unauth, 403 lowpriv) pass.

action_items: Fix POST /api/v1/customers/bulk-delete to add `uuid` validation rule before `exists` so non-UUID input returns 422 instead of 500. (CustomerController.php ~line 225.)
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerController::bulkDestroy uses `exists:customers,id` without first casting/validating UUID → causes 500 on malformed input. Add `uuid` rule.
bulkDestroy does not enforce that the calling admin actually owns/scopes these customers (no tenant check). If multi-tenancy is a concern this should scope to the auth user's tenant.
Response shape mixes `status:'success'`/`deleted:N` at root; the rest of the API uses `data` wrappers. Consider harmonizing.

success_rate.backend: 80% (4/5 pytest cases pass; 1 assertion fails due to real 500 bug on invalid-uuid input)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (E2E verified: select-all, per-row select, bulk-action-bar count, modal open/confirm, rows removed, green 3 customer(s) deleted notice, API returns 404 for deleted ids; sticky top-0 thead on both static-leases-container and dynamic-leases-container; Showing N leases present on both; tab labels also show counts 13/9; edit-customer-<id> navigates to /customers/:id/edit with 7/11 inputs pre-populated; delete-customer-modal opens on single-row delete)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend auth token lives in sessionStorage (not localStorage) — key is unnamed but the only value >40 chars that doesn't start with '{'. Use that to script API calls from the browser. Bulk-delete backend contract: root-level {status:'success', message, deleted:N}. Sticky header thead classes: 'sticky top-0 z-10'. Unregistered clients page conditionally renders only the active tab's container in the DOM — you must click the Dynamic / Manual tab before probing dynamic-leases-container.
rca of the issue: Bulk-delete 500 on invalid UUID: The 'exists:customers,id' validator issues a SELECT ... WHERE id = ? against a UUID column with a non-UUID string, and Postgres rejects the cast with SQLSTATE 22P02 before Laravel returns a validation error. Precede the exists rule with `uuid` so validation short-circuits with a 422 for malformed IDs.
